caption:
Your prayers today, and the one Allah singles out

Allah tells us to be mindful of the prayers, especially the middle prayer, and to stand before Him in complete devotion. Start the weekend by guarding each one.

Surah Al-Baqara 2:238

Pick one prayer today and give it your full attention.

#salah #prayer #surahbaqarah #weekendreminder

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
